sys_ui_page.description: Demo Data Builder installation and configuration checks
sys_ui_page.html:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
	<g:evaluate var="jvar_html">
		var live = String(RP.getParameterValue('live')) == 'true';
		var html;
		try {
			var check = new x_ddb.SetupCheck();
			html = check.renderHtml(check.run(live), live);
		} catch (e) {
			html = 'Setup check could not run: ' + x_ddb.SetupCheck.escape(e.message);
		}
		html;
	</g:evaluate>
	<g:no_escape>${jvar_html}</g:no_escape>
</j:jelly>
sys_ui_page.name: setup_check
